name: fleet-man integration VS Code customizations fixture
postStartCommand: nohup perl -MIO::Socket::INET -e 'my $s = IO::Socket::INET->new(LocalPort => 17390, Listen => 8, ReuseAddr => 1) or die "listen: $!"; while (my $c = $s->accept) { print $c "fleet-itest-forwarded\n"; close $c }' >/tmp/itest-forwarded.log 2>&1 </dev/null &
